rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating extent in all directions
unit of distance; first member of compound with mātrañ
mātram with sandhi before ca; limits extent to one krośa
worldly enjoyment; first member of compound with mukti
spiritual release; member of compound with phala
result or reward; member of compound with pradaḥ

items.question: What spatial extent and dual fruits are granted by this sacred presence?
premises: The influence extends on all sides.
The extent measures only one krośa.
The granted fruits are enjoyment and liberation.
items.inference: Within a radius of one krośa on all sides, this presence bestows both worldly enjoyment and spiritual liberation.
uncertainties: The exact length of a krośa is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: On all sides for the measure of one krośa, it grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.
